items.name: notification-badge
items.title: Notification Badge
items.description: A counter or dot pinned to an icon or avatar, with a transparent gap cut around it, so it reads on any background.

items.name: onboarding
items.title: Onboarding
items.description: A step-by-step onboarding flow with a segmented progress indicator and buttons to move between steps.

items.name: hint
items.title: Hint
items.description: A contextual help bubble that opens from a small trigger, built on the Base UI Popover.

items.name: infinite-scroll
items.title: Infinite Scroll
items.description: A list that fetches the next page as its end scrolls into view, below the items or, in reverse, above them. Works with any data library.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: A strip of items that slides in a seamless loop, in CSS alone, once they overflow. Supports reverse and vertical tracks, pause on hover, and edge fades with shadcn’s scroll-fade.

items.name: item-inset-separator
items.title: Item Inset Separator
items.description: A line along an Item's bottom that starts where its content starts, so it clears each Item's media.
